caption: The drawing features two distinct objects, both illustrated in color on a tan paper background. On the left side, there is a hairbrush composed of tightly bundled, vertical strands resembling coarse fibers or bristles, colored in shades of dark brown, yellow, and gray. The bundle is cinched near its base by a band or cord. On the right side, there is an object identified as beard tweezers, consisting of a twisted, elongated metal piece with a dark, metallic appearance and a central bulge, hanging by a cord. The cord forms a loose, irregular loop and is colored brown, with cross-hatching and sketch lines used to create shadow and texture around the object. Handwritten notes in pencil at the bottom describe each object and provide details such as their origins, materials, size, and associated tribes.
title: Hairbrush and Beard Tweezers
